4-1-1.q: True or false: The Creed is a short statement of what the Church believes. We say it at Mass.
Which word fits? “A statement of what the Church believes.”
4-1-1.why: Creed: A statement of what the Church believes.

4-1-1.q: Which word fits? “Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.”
4-1-1.why: faith: Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.

4-1-1.q: Catechism 186: “From the beginning, the _____ Church expressed and handed on her faith in brief formulae normative for all.”
4-1-1.why: CCC 186: “From the beginning, the apostolic Church expressed and handed on her faith in brief formulae normative for all.”

4-1-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Creed: a summary of our faith” teaches? “He taught the Creed to new Christians.”
4-1-1.why: Ambrose: he taught the Creed to new Christians.

4-1-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Creed: a summary of our faith”?
4-1-1.why: Romans 10:9-10 is the passage for this lesson.

4-1-2.q: True or false: Faith is trusting God and believing what he reveals. It is a gift and also our free response.
Which word fits? “Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.”
4-1-2.why: faith: Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.

4-1-2.q: Which word fits? “God showing himself and his plan to us, in the Bible and in Jesus.”
4-1-2.why: Revelation: God showing himself and his plan to us, in the Bible and in Jesus.

4-1-2.q: Catechism 153: “Peter confessed that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God, Jesus declared to him that this _____ did not come "from flesh and blood", but from "my Father who is in heaven".”
4-1-2.why: CCC 153: “Peter confessed that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God, Jesus declared to him that this revelation did not come "from flesh and blood", but from "my Father who is in heaven".”

4-1-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Faith: a gift and a choice” teaches? “Models of faith.”
4-1-2.why: Abraham and Mary: models of faith.

4-1-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Faith: a gift and a choice”?
4-1-2.why: Hebrews 11:1-3 is the passage for this lesson.

4-1-3.q: True or false: We believe in one God: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. The Trinity is the central mystery of faith.
Which word fits? “One God in three Persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.”
4-1-3.why: Trinity: One God in three Persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

4-1-3.q: Catechism 232: “Christians are baptized "in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit" Before receiving the _____, they respond to a three-part question when asked to confess the Father, the Son and the Spirit:”
4-1-3.why: CCC 232: “Christians are baptized "in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit" Before receiving the sacrament, they respond to a three-part question when asked to confess the Father, the Son and the Spirit:”

4-1-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “One God in three Persons” teaches? “He defended the Trinity at Nicaea.”
4-1-3.why: Athanasius: he defended the Trinity at Nicaea.

4-1-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “One God in three Persons”?
4-1-3.why: Matthew 28:19 is the passage for this lesson.

4-2-1.q: True or false: God created out of nothing and out of love. Creation is good and ordered.
Which word fits? “Everything God made, from nothing, because he is good.”
4-2-1.why: creation: Everything God made, from nothing, because he is good.

4-2-1.q: Which word fits? “God, who made everything that exists.”
4-2-1.why: Creator: God, who made everything that exists.

4-2-1.q: Catechism 279: “the profession of faith takes them up when it confesses that God the Father almighty is "_____ of heaven and earth" (Apostles' Creed), "of all that is, seen and unseen" (Nicene Creed).”
4-2-1.why: CCC 279: “the profession of faith takes them up when it confesses that God the Father almighty is "Creator of heaven and earth" (Apostles' Creed), "of all that is, seen and unseen" (Nicene Creed).”

4-2-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God made everything good” teaches? “Canticle of the Creatures.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God made everything good”?
4-2-1.why: Genesis 1:1-31 is the passage for this lesson.

4-2-2.q: True or false: God made angels and humans. Angels are spirit creatures who serve God. Humans have body and soul.
Which word fits? “A spiritual being without a body who serves God and watches over us.”
4-2-2.why: angel: A spiritual being without a body who serves God and watches over us.

4-2-2.q: Which word fits? “The spiritual part of a person that lives forever and cannot be seen.”
4-2-2.why: soul: The spiritual part of a person that lives forever and cannot be seen.

4-2-2.q: Catechism 355: “"God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him, male and female he created them." Man occupies a unique place in _____:”
4-2-2.why: CCC 355: “"God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him, male and female he created them." Man occupies a unique place in creation:”

4-2-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Angels and humans” teaches? “Devotion to guardian angels.”
4-2-2.why: Padre Pio: devotion to guardian angels.

4-2-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Angels and humans”?
4-2-2.why: Psalm 148 is the passage for this lesson.

4-2-3.q: True or false: Adam and Eve sinned. Sin entered the world. God promised a Redeemer.
Which word fits? “The first sin of Adam and Eve, which wounded human nature; Baptism frees us from it.”
4-2-3.why: original sin: The first sin of Adam and Eve, which wounded human nature; Baptism frees us from it.

4-2-3.q: Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
4-2-3.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

4-2-3.q: Catechism 385: “The _____ of divine love in Christ manifested at the same time the extent of evil and the superabundance of grace.”
4-2-3.why: CCC 385: “The revelation of divine love in Christ manifested at the same time the extent of evil and the superabundance of grace.”

4-2-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The fall and God’s promise” teaches? “Preserved from original sin.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The fall and God’s promise”?
4-2-3.why: Genesis 3 is the passage for this lesson.

4-3-1.q: True or false: The Son of God became man. He was born of the Virgin Mary.
Which word fits? “God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.”
4-3-1.why: Incarnation: God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.

4-3-1.q: Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
4-3-1.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

4-3-1.q: Catechism 464: “The unique and altogether singular event of the _____ of the Son of God does not mean that Jesus Christ is part God and part man, nor does it imply that he is the result of a confused mixture of the divine and the human.”
4-3-1.why: CCC 464: “The unique and altogether singular event of the Incarnation of the Son of God does not mean that Jesus Christ is part God and part man, nor does it imply that he is the result of a confused mixture of the divine and the human.”

4-3-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Conceived by the Holy Spirit” teaches? “Protector of Jesus.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Conceived by the Holy Spirit”?
4-3-1.why: Luke 1:26-38 is the passage for this lesson.

4-3-2.q: True or false: Jesus suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, was buried and rose on the third day.
Which word fits? “Jesus’ suffering, death, Resurrection and Ascension, by which he saves us.”
4-3-2.why: Paschal Mystery: Jesus’ suffering, death, Resurrection and Ascension, by which he saves us.

4-3-2.q: Which word fits? “Jesus buying us back from sin and death by his cross and Resurrection.”
4-3-2.why: redemption: Jesus buying us back from sin and death by his cross and Resurrection.

4-3-2.q: Catechism 571: “The Paschal mystery of Christ's cross and _____ stands at the centre of the Good News that the apostles, and the Church following them, are to proclaim to the world.”
4-3-2.why: CCC 571: “The Paschal mystery of Christ's cross and Resurrection stands at the centre of the Good News that the apostles, and the Church following them, are to proclaim to the world.”

4-3-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Suffered, died, rose” teaches? “Tradition says she wiped Jesus’s face.”
4-3-2.why: Veronica: tradition says she wiped Jesus’s face.

4-3-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Suffered, died, rose”?
4-3-2.why: John 19:16-30 is the passage for this lesson.

4-3-3.q: True or false: Jesus ascended to the Father. He will come again to judge the living and the dead.
Which word fits? “Jesus returning to the Father in heaven forty days after Easter.”
4-3-3.why: Ascension: Jesus returning to the Father in heaven forty days after Easter.

4-3-3.q: Which word fits? “God’s verdict on each life at death and on the whole world at the end.”
4-3-3.why: judgment: God’s verdict on each life at death and on the whole world at the end.

4-3-3.q: Catechism 659: “Jesus' final apparition ends with the irreversible entry of his humanity into divine glory, symbolized by the cloud and by _____, where he is seated from that time forward at God's right hand.”
4-3-3.why: CCC 659: “Jesus' final apparition ends with the irreversible entry of his humanity into divine glory, symbolized by the cloud and by heaven, where he is seated from that time forward at God's right hand.”

4-3-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Ascended and will come again” teaches? “He awaited Christ’s coming.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Ascended and will come again”?
4-3-3.why: Acts 1:6-11 is the passage for this lesson.

4-4-1.q: True or false: The Holy Spirit is God. He gives life, inspires Scripture and guides the Church.
Which word fits? “The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.”
4-4-1.why: Holy Spirit: The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.

4-4-1.q: Which word fits? “The day the Holy Spirit came on the apostles; the Church’s birthday.”
4-4-1.why: Pentecost: The day the Holy Spirit came on the apostles; the Church’s birthday.

4-4-1.q: Catechism 685: “To believe in the Holy Spirit is to profess that the Holy Spirit is one of the persons of the Holy _____, consubstantial with the Father and the Son:”
4-4-1.why: CCC 685: “To believe in the Holy Spirit is to profess that the Holy Spirit is one of the persons of the Holy Trinity, consubstantial with the Father and the Son:”

4-4-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Holy Spirit gives life” teaches? “A fisherman who denied Jesus and was forgiven, and became the first pope.”
4-4-1.why: Peter: a fisherman who denied Jesus and was forgiven, and became the first pope.

4-4-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Holy Spirit gives life”?
4-4-1.why: Acts 2:1-13 is the passage for this lesson.

4-4-2.q: True or false: The Church is one body with Jesus as the head. All members are needed.
Which word fits? “The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.”
4-4-2.why: Church: The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.

4-4-2.q: Which word fits? “The Church, in which Jesus is the head and we are members.”
4-4-2.why: Body of Christ: The Church, in which Jesus is the head and we are members.

4-4-2.q: Catechism 779: “The _____ is both visible and spiritual, a hierarchical society and the Mystical Body of Christ.”
4-4-2.why: CCC 779: “The Church is both visible and spiritual, a hierarchical society and the Mystical Body of Christ.”

4-4-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Church as the Body of Christ” teaches? “He taught the Body.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Church as the Body of Christ”?
4-4-2.why: 1 Corinthians 12:12-27 is the passage for this lesson.

4-4-3.q: True or false: The Church is one, holy, catholic and apostolic. These marks come from Christ.
Which word fits? “The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.”
4-4-3.why: Church: The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.

4-4-3.q: Which word fits? “A word meaning “universal”: for everyone, everywhere, with the fullness of the faith.”
4-4-3.why: catholic: A word meaning “universal”: for everyone, everywhere, with the fullness of the faith.

4-4-3.q: Catechism 811: “"This is the sole _____ of Christ, which in the Creed we profess to be one, holy, catholic and apostolic." These four characteristics, inseparably linked with each other, indicate essential features of the Church and her mission.”
4-4-3.why: CCC 811: “"This is the sole Church of Christ, which in the Creed we profess to be one, holy, catholic and apostolic." These four characteristics, inseparably linked with each other, indicate essential features of the Church and her mission.”

4-4-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Marks of the Church” teaches? “He first used the word catholic.”
4-4-3.why: Ignatius of Antioch: he first used the word catholic.

4-4-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Marks of the Church”?
4-4-3.why: Ephesians 4:4-6 is the passage for this lesson.

4-5-1.q: True or false: All members of Christ are connected. The saints in heaven pray for us.
Which word fits? “The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.”
4-5-1.why: communion of saints: The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.

4-5-1.q: Which word fits? “A holy person who is with God in heaven.”
4-5-1.why: saint: A holy person who is with God in heaven.

4-5-1.q: Catechism 946: “After confessing "the holy _____ Church," the Apostles' Creed adds "the communion of saints." In a certain sense this article is a further explanation of the preceding:”
4-5-1.why: CCC 946: “After confessing "the holy catholic Church," the Apostles' Creed adds "the communion of saints." In a certain sense this article is a further explanation of the preceding:”

4-5-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Communion of saints” teaches? “Promised to spend heaven doing good on earth.”
4-5-1.why: Therese: promised to spend heaven doing good on earth.

4-5-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Communion of saints”?
4-5-1.why: Hebrews 12:1-2 is the passage for this lesson.

4-5-2.q: True or false: God forgives sins through Baptism and Reconciliation.
Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
4-5-2.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

4-5-2.q: Which word fits? “Love that forgives and helps those who are suffering or in need.”
4-5-2.why: mercy: Love that forgives and helps those who are suffering or in need.

4-5-2.q: Catechism 976: “The Apostle's Creed associates faith in the forgiveness of sins not only with faith in the Holy Spirit, but also with faith in the _____ and in the communion of saints.”
4-5-2.why: CCC 976: “The Apostle's Creed associates faith in the forgiveness of sins not only with faith in the Holy Spirit, but also with faith in the Church and in the communion of saints.”

4-5-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Forgiveness of sins” teaches? “Confessor.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Forgiveness of sins”?
4-5-2.why: John 20:21-23 is the passage for this lesson.

4-5-3.q: True or false: At the end we will rise. The faithful live with God forever.
Which word fits? “Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.”
4-5-3.why: heaven: Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.

4-5-3.q: Which word fits? “Life with God that never ends.”
4-5-3.why: eternal life: Life with God that never ends.

4-5-3.q: Catechism 997: “God, in his almighty power, will definitively grant incorruptible life to our bodies by reuniting them with our souls, through the power of Jesus' _____.”
4-5-3.why: CCC 997: “God, in his almighty power, will definitively grant incorruptible life to our bodies by reuniting them with our souls, through the power of Jesus' Resurrection.”

4-5-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Resurrection of the body and life everlasting” teaches? “Raised by Jesus.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Resurrection of the body and life everlasting”?
4-5-3.why: 1 Corinthians 15 is the passage for this lesson.

4-6-1.q: True or false: Mary was conceived without original sin by God’s grace.
Which word fits? “Mary was kept free from original sin from the first moment of her life.”
4-6-1.why: Immaculate Conception: Mary was kept free from original sin from the first moment of her life.

4-6-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
4-6-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

4-6-1.q: Catechism 491: “Through the centuries the _____ has become ever more aware that Mary, "full of grace" through God, was redeemed from the moment of her conception.”
4-6-1.why: CCC 491: “Through the centuries the Church has become ever more aware that Mary, "full of grace" through God, was redeemed from the moment of her conception.”

4-6-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Immaculate Conception” teaches? “Mary said, “I am the Immaculate Conception.”.”
4-6-1.why: Bernadette: Mary said, “I am the Immaculate Conception.”.

4-6-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Immaculate Conception”?
4-6-1.why: Luke 1:28 is the passage for this lesson.

4-6-2.q: True or false: Mary is the Mother of God because Jesus is God.
Which word fits? “Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.”
4-6-2.why: Mother of God: Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.

4-6-2.q: Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
4-6-2.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

4-6-2.q: Catechism 495: “In fact, the One whom she conceived as man by the Holy Spirit, who truly became her Son according to the flesh, was none other than the Father's eternal Son, the second person of the Holy _____.”
4-6-2.why: CCC 495: “In fact, the One whom she conceived as man by the Holy Spirit, who truly became her Son according to the flesh, was none other than the Father's eternal Son, the second person of the Holy Trinity.”

4-6-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Mother of God” teaches? “Defender of the title.”
4-6-2.why: Cyril of Alexandria: defender of the title.

4-6-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Mother of God”?
4-6-2.why: Luke 1:43 is the passage for this lesson.

4-6-3.q: True or false: Mary was taken body and soul into heaven.
Which word fits? “Mary was taken up body and soul into heaven at the end of her life.”
4-6-3.why: Assumption: Mary was taken up body and soul into heaven at the end of her life.

4-6-3.q: Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
4-6-3.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

4-6-3.q: Catechism 975: “"We believe that the Holy Mother of God, the new Eve, Mother of the _____, continues in heaven to exercise her maternal role on behalf of the members of Christ" (Paul VI, CPG # 15).”
4-6-3.why: CCC 975: “"We believe that the Holy Mother of God, the new Eve, Mother of the Church, continues in heaven to exercise her maternal role on behalf of the members of Christ" (Paul VI, CPG # 15).”

4-6-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Assumption and Queen of Heaven” teaches? “Defined the Assumption.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Assumption and Queen of Heaven”?
4-6-3.why: Revelation 12:1 is the passage for this lesson.

4-7-1.q: True or false: Christ instituted the sacraments. Each gives grace through a sign.
Which word fits? “An outward sign Jesus gave that really gives us God’s grace.”
4-7-1.why: sacrament: An outward sign Jesus gave that really gives us God’s grace.

4-7-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
4-7-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

4-7-1.q: Catechism 1113: “The whole liturgical life of the _____ revolves around the Eucharistic sacrifice and the sacraments.”
4-7-1.why: CCC 1113: “The whole liturgical life of the Church revolves around the Eucharistic sacrifice and the sacraments.”

4-7-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Seven sacraments” teaches? “Sacraments.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Seven sacraments”?
4-7-1.why: Mark 16:15-16 is the passage for this lesson.

4-7-2.q: True or false: Virtues are habits that help us do good. Conscience guides our choices.
Which word fits? “A good habit that helps us do what is right.”
4-7-2.why: virtue: A good habit that helps us do what is right.

4-7-2.q: Which word fits? “The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.”
4-7-2.why: conscience: The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.

4-7-2.q: Catechism 1776: “"Deep within his _____ man discovers a law which he has not laid upon himself but which he must obey.”
4-7-2.why: CCC 1776: “"Deep within his conscience man discovers a law which he has not laid upon himself but which he must obey.”

4-7-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Virtues and conscience” teaches? “Virtues.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Virtues and conscience”?
4-7-2.why: Philippians 4:8 is the passage for this lesson.

4-7-3.q: True or false: The Beatitudes and Commandments show how to love.
Which word fits? “Jesus’ eight sayings on the path to true happiness.”
4-7-3.why: Beatitudes: Jesus’ eight sayings on the path to true happiness.

4-7-3.q: Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
4-7-3.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

4-7-3.q: Catechism 1716: “the _____ fulfill the promises by ordering them no longer merely to the possession of a territory, but to the Kingdom of heaven:”
4-7-3.why: CCC 1716: “the Beatitudes fulfill the promises by ordering them no longer merely to the possession of a territory, but to the Kingdom of heaven:”

4-7-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Beatitudes and Commandments” teaches? “Lived justice.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Beatitudes and Commandments”?
4-7-3.why: Matthew 22:37-40 is the passage for this lesson.

4-8-1.q: True or false: The Our Father is the summary of the Gospel. Each petition has meaning.
Which word fits? “The prayer Jesus taught us.”
4-8-1.why: Our Father: The prayer Jesus taught us.

4-8-1.q: Which word fits? “Asking God for what we need.”
4-8-1.why: petition: Asking God for what we need.

4-8-1.q: Catechism 2763: “It is in this context that each _____ bequeathed to us by the Lord is illuminated:”
4-8-1.why: CCC 2763: “It is in this context that each petition bequeathed to us by the Lord is illuminated:”

4-8-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Praying the Our Father” teaches? “Wrote on the Lord’s Prayer.”
4-8-1.why: Cyprian: wrote on the Lord’s Prayer.

4-8-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Praying the Our Father”?
4-8-1.why: Matthew 6:9-13 is the passage for this lesson.

4-8-2.q: True or false: We pray in blessing, adoration, petition, intercession, thanksgiving and praise. We use vocal prayer, meditation, contemplation.
Which word fits? “Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.”
4-8-2.why: praise: Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.

4-8-2.q: Catechism 2644: “The Holy Spirit who teaches the _____ and recalls to her all that Jesus said also instructs her in the life of prayer, inspiring new expressions of the same basic forms of prayer:”
4-8-2.why: CCC 2644: “The Holy Spirit who teaches the Church and recalls to her all that Jesus said also instructs her in the life of prayer, inspiring new expressions of the same basic forms of prayer:”

4-8-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Forms and expressions of prayer” teaches? “Contemplative.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Forms and expressions of prayer”?
4-8-2.why: Psalm 63:1-8 is the passage for this lesson.

4-8-3.q: True or false: The Church year celebrates the mystery of Christ. The Mass is the center.
Which word fits? “The Church’s year of seasons that retells the life of Christ.”
4-8-3.why: liturgical year: The Church’s year of seasons that retells the life of Christ.

4-8-3.q: Which word fits? “The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.”
4-8-3.why: Mass: The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.

4-8-3.q: Catechism 1163: “"Holy Mother _____ believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”
4-8-3.why: CCC 1163: “"Holy Mother Church believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”

4-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Liturgical year and the Mass” teaches? “Frequent Communion.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Liturgical year and the Mass”?
4-8-3.why: Luke 24:13-35 is the passage for this lesson.
